_comment: Frozen release-project slice for the linear-release-audit dry run. Contains, by construction: a falsely-complete gate, a gate with no linked implementation, a date incoherence, a dependency scheduled after its dependent, and a milestone whose progress contradicts its description.

project.name: Road to MVP-1 — Aug 13 authenticated reports

milestones.name: MVP-1 release gate
milestones.description: Named client login → correct report aligned with the presented artifact → all reachable claims auditable → attributable feedback persists → unauthorized access rejected.

milestones._note: progress contradicts the description — the §5 trap
milestones.name: Deal recall → 12/12
milestones.description: ⚠️ This milestone shows 100% because its issues are closed, NOT because 12/12 was reached. The actual result is 10/12 deals. The last 2 were not recovered and may not be publicly reachable.

release_criteria.text: A named client user authenticates and is authorized to exactly the reports assigned to them.
One same-origin deployment serves the built frontend and both frozen report packs.
Every client-reachable surface is auditable: an inventory naming each route and its provenance verdict.
Report feedback persists, attributed to the authenticated user, and survives a restart.
The served reports match the client-presented versions claim for claim.

issues._scenario: falsely complete — implementation merged, acceptance artifact never executed
issues.title: MVP-1 Gate C — Make every client-reachable surface auditable
issues.acceptance: An inventory naming each client-reachable route and its provenance verdict.

issues.title: MVP-1 Gate E — Align served reports with the client-presented versions
issues.acceptance: A claim-by-claim diff of served vs presented, with zero unexplained rows.

issues.title: MVP-1 Gate B — Deploy one same-origin app serving both frozen reports
issues.acceptance: The client URL serves the frontend and both packs from one origin, verified from a machine that has never seen the repo.

issues._scenario: no linked implementation — no branch, no PR, no commit
issues.title: MVP-1 Gate D — Capture durable attributable report feedback
issues.acceptance: Feedback survives a container restart and carries the authenticated user id.

issues._scenario: blocked, and its blocker is scheduled AFTER it — date incoherence
issues.title: MVP-1 Gate A — Authenticate named client users and authorize report access
issues.acceptance: A cross-tenant read returns 403 in the deployed smoke run.

issues._scenario: the blocker, due after its dependent, and due after the gate date
issues.title: Choose minimal auth/session mechanism and add named identity model

issues._scenario: commercial — real-world state not establishable from the workspace
issues.title: Confirm the named client can reach the link from their own network

issues._scenario: stretch — must never be counted against the gate
issues.title: STRETCH — Generate full-text-enriched report variants
